cohort: Pregnant women who had a live, term, single-intrauterine pregnancy without detectable fetal abnormality at the time of starting labor were recruited.
finding: Neonatal deaths without detected prenatal risk factors were associated with male sex, low Apgar score, gestational age above 40 weeks, and assisted vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of neonatal death.
gest_age: Term (37-41 weeks) for the general cohort; gestational age above 40 weeks was identified as a risk factor.
